QUICK START

How to play

  1. Place & aim

    Before each launch, tap or drag on the field to position your paddle. Set the shot angle with the slider and follow the gold arrow. The ball goes in the direction you choose. Tap Launch when ready.

  2. Aim your return

    During play, slide left or right to catch the ball. A centre paddle hit goes straight up; hits nearer the left or right edge aim that way. Solid gray walls reflect the ball. Clear every colored brick to finish the stage.

  3. Catch the labeled boosts

    Move the paddle beneath a falling pickup. Touching a brick does not activate it. Each caught pickup applies once.

Your progress saves automatically.

No Save button is needed. You can leave the app and continue your field later. Optional sign-in syncs completed stages and history; your current field stays on this phone.

Lives & stages

Missing every ball costs one life. Broken bricks stay broken during that attempt. Complete all 12 starter stages to unlock stage 13, then clear journey stages in order.

Replay for mastery

★ Manual clear: finish without using autoplay. ✦ Clean manual clear: finish without autoplay or losing a life. Assisted clears still open the next stage. Replay any completed stage to improve its stamp and your personal manual best.

Play at your pace

AUTO opens your time bank. Choose 15 seconds, 30 seconds, or a smaller remaining balance. Autoplay uses the same paddle and physics. Touch, move the pointer, press an arrow or tap Take control to stop it. Pausing or finishing the stage returns unused time. Manual play and retries need no account, ad or purchase.

1×, 2× and 4× change playback speed. Your bank counts active real seconds at every speed. Both manual and assisted clears earn campaign completion ticks.

Keyboard: ← → or A/D move · Space launches · P pauses.

Autoplay time

Choose a short helping hand. Take control any time. Only active real seconds are used; unused time stays in your shared bank.

Starting requires a connection. Pausing, leaving the app, losing a life or completing the stage ends this activation. It never starts the next stage for you.

Manual rewards load with your time bank.
